text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing,
Dream Journey mentioned she had somewhere to stop by today as well.
choice_data_list: Can I come with you too?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Of course. If it is what you yourself
desire, Trainer, then you are most welcome.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We visited a specialty tea shop where large
shelves were lined with countless types of tea leaves.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: "Sensei," it has been a long time.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The shopkeeper here possesses
wonderful insight, especially when it comes to tea.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Being of humble knowledge, I often seek guidance from others,
which is why I address them as "Sensei."

text_block_list.name: Elderly Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. For all your talk, you barely ever show your face.
Heartless disciple of mine.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Now, now, don't say that.
I've brought the antique ceramics you requested today."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: The warehouse in the back, as usual, works for you, yes?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. I apologize, but could you wait for just a moment?
I'm going to put away my souvenirs.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While waiting for Dream Journey to return,
I look around the shop.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The shelves were packed with tea leaves, tea leaves, and more tea leaves.
Suddenly, I found myself wanting to know
the reasons behind their different names."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Is it the taste, the origin, or something unknown?
What about its history, its aroma? Its color?
Just thinking about it gets me so excited!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
…………What the hell are you staring at?
If you're looking to order something—
choice_data_list: I'd love to try the 'Doctor's' recommended tea!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Someone whom Dream Journey looks up to as a mentor.
A chance to seek instruction from such a person
might never come again.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Once I thought of that, I couldn't stop.
It seems that once you get a taste of the thrill of gaining new knowledge,
it becomes downright addictive—"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: The courage to step into the darkness in order to seek knowledge. Sometimes I wonder if that is what is being tested.
choice_data_list: Please teach me about tea too!
Please teach me about tea too!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Ha. Looking like you can't even tell black tea
from oolong—wait a second, could it be?

text_block_list.name: Elderly Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
If you're going to go that far, perhaps I'll bring out something special.
I just received a shipment of rare tea leaves, you see.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: It's the 'real deal' tea that tea connoisseurs drool over. If you miss it today, who knows when you'll ever encounter it again—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: My, you certainly look like you're having fun.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: However, I believe it is still too early for you to take "Professor's" lessons, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: We can resume the lesson another time. I shall take my leave for today.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —...Fufu!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Did you perhaps want to try a sip since it was offered?
Is that what that look on your face means?
choice_data_list: Because it was a chance to learn something new.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
My sincerest apologies.
Next time, I shall simply watch over you.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, you're quite bold, Trainer.
Drinking tea worth hundreds of thousands of yen
right on the spot like that."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Assuming it has to be a joke,
I look at Dream Journey's face, but—"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Yes. Didn't they say it was the "real deal"? The tea they recommended to you was of that sort.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Since ancient times, it's been said that overindulgence in tea
can ruin one's morals and way of life.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"So there exist worlds so profound
that one needs true resolve just to know them."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Still—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"To someone who loves to teach, someone as honest
and earnest as you must be truly irresistible."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Because she absorbs everything without a single doubt, it makes me want to keep pouring the waters of wisdom into her endlessly.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: "However, please remember: there is nothing more dangerous than half-baked knowledge."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Make sure to choose someone trustworthy for "Sensei."
Can you make me that promise?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Oh, I'm the "teacher"?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Fufu...
And here I just told you to choose your opponents wisely.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"—Very well.
Since you were so kind as to request me, I shall humbly accept."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Next time, allow me to guide you
to yet another new world."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
There is no need to rush.
Knowledge is something built up over time.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
If I may be so bold, allow me to assist you.
All you need to do is believe and rely on me...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite it being a reassuring offer,
for some reason, a cold sweat ran down my spine.
